evidence.support: Choosing whether to buy or sell Nifty index futures for a portfolio hedge tests index-futures hedging.

mappings.note: This is the contract-direction component of a hedge against an expected market fall.

evidence.support: Choosing the number and direction of Nifty index-futures contracts is an index-futures portfolio hedge.

mappings.note: The tested decision is the futures hedge position for the stock portfolio.

evidence.support: Selecting a Nifty futures position and contract count for the portfolio is index-futures hedging.

mappings.note: This option specifies a buy position in index futures as a portfolio hedge.

evidence.support: Selling Nifty index futures to offset portfolio market exposure tests index-futures hedging.

mappings.note: The option specifies the hedge direction and number of index futures contracts.

evidence.support: Calculating the net gain or loss when Nifty falls and the portfolio is hedged tests the outcome of an index-futures hedge.

mappings.note: The stock and index price changes determine the combined hedged portfolio result.

evidence.support: Calculating portfolio net gain or loss under a Nifty rise tests the performance of an index-futures hedge.

mappings.note: This evaluates the combined stock and futures result when the market moves upward.
